fit.title: Cycle-normalized scenario DCF
fit.reason: Commodity or semiconductor cycle peaks can distort a single year’s earnings. Use normalized cash flows across a cycle and compare enterprise multiples.
fit.caution: A latest-year extrapolation is only a starting scenario, not a normalized mid-cycle forecast.
fit.statement: No model is always most accurate. This is an explainable starting point, not a verified survey of current Wall Street analyst usage.
